newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Krueng said to seek Busang deadline extension.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Krueng said to seek Busang deadline extension.

text.p: PT Krueng Gasui (KG) and Golden Valley Mines NL said on Wednesday that Krueng intends to make a request for an extension of the deadline to conclude joint venture negotiations over the Busang gold deposit in Kalimantan, Indonesia.

In a joint statement released to the Australian Stock Exchange on Wednesday, but dated December 3, the companies said talks aimed at resolving the underlying tenure dispute regarding the Busang deposit had been held in Jakarta and that the parties were optimistic that an early resolution could be achieved.
As a result of these discussions, the parties are optimistic that an early resolution can be achieved, the statement said.
Canada-based Bre-X Minerals Ltd and KG had agreed to hold further talks at an early date, it said.
The request for an extension was to be made to Indonesia's Ministry of Mines and Energy, the statement said.

Christopher Ferrier, company secretary for Golden Valley, declined to elaborate on the statement and would not say whether the talks would affect a December 4 deadline for Bre-X to make a deal with Canada's Barrick gold Corp
